name: Herald
idea: The white stork, Moldova's bringer of good news, flies level with a parcel hanging from its coral beak, drawn as one crescent-wing silhouette.
why: Everyone in Moldova already says the stork brings things, so the mark explains the service without a word and claims a local, emotional symbol no carrier uses.
risks: A pictorial bird loses detail below about 32 px, and any stork carrying something from its beak can still remind locals of the national 'Wine of Moldova' stork, so it needs a trademark check.

colors.name: Graphite
colors.use: Stork, parcel and wordmark; brand ground behind the reversed logo and the app icon
